name: OctreeVoxelGrid
definition: A multi-resolution octree voxel grid that satisfies the VoxelGrid protocol, enabling swap-in at engine init with zero changes to handlers or engine code. It uses O(active cells × layers) memory instead of O(grid³).
summary: OctreeVoxelGrid is a sparse, multi-resolution voxel structure that replaces uniform grids, storing only active regions to save memory while supporting dynamic refinement and inheriting parent values to avoid interpolation artifacts.
